map.Hello World! 这是测试文本，测试字符频率。Hello ToolBox: Hello World! This is sample text to test character frequency. Hello ToolBox!
map.密码学/信息论教学：统计一段明文的字母频率，直观看到英文 e/t/a 高频、中文: Cryptography / information-theory teaching: count letter frequency in plaintext to see at a glance that e/t/a dominate in English and that Chinese follows character-frequency distributions.
map.文本熵粗估：用字符分布估算压缩潜力或随机性，辅助判断是否为加密/乱码。: Rough text-entropy estimate: use the character distribution to estimate compression potential or randomness, helping tell whether text is encrypted or garbled.
map.词频与用词习惯分析：统计稿件中高频字，发现重复用词以便润色。: Word-frequency and usage analysis: count high-frequency characters in a draft to spot repetition for polishing.
map.字符 a 出现 5 次、b 2 次、r 2 次、c 1 次、d 1 次，共 11: The character a appears 5 times, b 2, r 2, c 1 and d 1, for 11 characters total; a has a frequency of 45.5%. This maps exactly to the "high-frequency letter exposure" teaching point in Caesar / Vigenere frequency analysis.
map.默认区分，因密码分析常需保留大小写差异；如需语言字频对比，先统一大小写再统计，否: By default yes, because cryptanalysis often needs the case difference; for language frequency comparison, unify the case first, otherwise A and a are counted as two characters.
map.空格和标点算字符吗？: Do spaces and punctuation count as characters?
map.可选。做信息论熵估计时通常计入空格；做纯用词分析时建议排除标点与空白，只留有效字: Optional. Entropy estimates for information theory usually include spaces; for pure word analysis, exclude punctuation and whitespace and keep only meaningful characters.
